title: Model Compatibility & Procurement Signals — Sales Enablement Dossier and Rapid Recon Plan
creator: Ana Kaur
description: Context: Sales and AE teams lack a concise reference that maps common enterprise procurement concerns (latency SLOs, regional model availability, quantization tradeoffs, and fallback economics) to the concrete compatibility, rollout, and cost implications of Redwood's model variants and deployment modes. Objective: Produce a compact sales-facing dossier + quick recon plan for SEs and Solutions Engineers that can be used during RFP/procurement conversations and evaluated live during customer discovery calls. Scope: 1) Competitive compatibility matrix for top 6 model families (open and managed) vs. Redwood deployment modes. 2) Procurement signal checklist (contract triggers, latency thresholds, EEA/data residency questions) mapped to recommended playbooks (hosted, dedicated, private). 3) 2-page slide + 1-page cheat sheet for AEs; 1-page technical appendix for SEs with quick verification commands and dashboards to run during calls. 4) Rapid recon script for SDRs/field researchers to capture procurement signals from prospect calls and public procurement docs.
acceptance_criteria: One 8-slide sales deck (PDF + editable) with a clear competitive compatibility slide and two procurement play examples
One 1-page AE cheat sheet summarizing: fallback options, expected unit-cost delta, and recommended contract language
Technical appendix with quick checks: sample API calls, latency baseline queries, and Console dashboard links
Rapid recon script with 10 prioritized signal questions and a Google Form for field capture
Peer review completed by Solutions Engineering and Legal (notes captured), and SE play tested in at least two customer discovery calls

Metrics for success: AE adoption (measured by usage of deck in SFDC opps), two successful SE playtests, and reduction in procurement back-and-forth time on pilot contracts by 20% in pilot accounts.
